connect.metaTitle: AI connection — Georgia’s budget data in your assistant
connect.metaDescription: Connect your AI assistant to Fiscal.ge’s verified budget data, with sources, caveats and precise coverage for every figure.
connect.claudeStep3: Paste the address above and confirm.
connect.codexStep4: Paste the address above into the URL field. Leave Bearer token and Headers empty.
connect.chatPrompt: Answer my question using Fiscal.ge’s published data:
connect.notServed1: Quarterly and monthly data — only annual data has been verified
connect.heading: Connect your AI assistant
connect.introduction: Fiscal.ge’s verified data on Georgia, available in your AI assistant.
connect.otherClients: The same address works in other clients that support remote MCP servers. Add it without authentication. Menu names vary by client and version.
connect.withoutConnection: Ask directly in chat, without connecting
connect.webSearchPrompt: If your assistant can search the web, start with:
connect.webSearchNote: This lets the assistant read the site’s pages, methodology and published files to find real figures. It does not provide the connection’s direct link from each figure to its sources and caveats, such as a warning that two years are not comparable. Use the connection for precise citations.
connect.unsupported: For questions about these excluded areas, the assistant is given an explanation that the data is unavailable, rather than an invented figure.
connect.technical: Technical details: the server provides read-only access to data. Protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP, revision 2025-11-25. It is stateless and accepts POST requests only. Call tools/list to retrieve the tool list.
connect.excludedCodes: Also excluded: codes {codes}. Their budgets are not territorially attributable expenditure, so a question about one of these codes returns an explanation instead of a figure.
